Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase. The Afghanistan players make their way out to the middle. Followed by Andy Balbirnie and Paul Stirling who walk out to open for Ireland. Fazalhaq Farooqi to start with the new ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Now the target is a big one but Ireland have batted decently in this tournament but here they’ll have to bat at their best. Afghanistan will back their bowlers to defend this. The chase on the other side. Stay tuned.

Ireland will be disappointed with the way they bowled. They began really well but after the Powerplay lost the plot. There were far too many extras too from them which did not help their cause. Overall, they might feel they missed a trick this time around, especially after bowling so well in the first two games.

The start though was a slow one. The two openers were quite watchful in the first 6 but once set, they did step on the gas. They laid the platform for a good score. Gurbaz scored a half ton and ended as the top scorer. However, cameos down the order from the two Zadrans also helped take Afghanistan to a very good total.

End of a power-packed batting performance from the visitors and they have got themselves into a good position to bag their first win of the tournament. Ireland could not maintain the pressure with the ball and would be disappointed with their effort.

OUT! CAUGHT! Najibullah Zadran tries to go for a biggie again but finds the fielder. Short ball, outside off. Zadran stays back and pulls it to deep square leg. Fionn Hand stationed there takes a solid catch. Najibullah Zadran's brisk innings of 42 comes to an end. Afghanistan ends their innings at 189/5.
Commentary.Howout: c Fionn Hand b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Najibullah Zadran wants to get closer to that 190 mark. It is short, on off. Zadran smokes it over the wide long on fence for a maximum.
A low full toss, around off. Zadran mistimes his pull towards deep mid-wicket. It lands safely. They take two.
SIX! All the way! It is fuller, in the slot. Zadran heaves it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Short one, around off. Zadran swings but misses.

OUT! RUN OUT! Really great work in the field by Harry Tector. It is short, on off. Nabi pulls it to deep mid-wicket. It could've gone over the ropes but Harry Tector makes a valiant effort to stop the ball. The batters decide to take three but it isn't the right decision. Harry Tector throws it to the bowler at the non-striker's end who is quick to take the bails off. Mohammad Nabi is well short of the crease.
Change. Mark Adair to bowl the final over.
SIX! Consecutive maximums. It is full, outside off. Najibullah Zadran swings hard at it and sends it sailing over the cover fence for a biggie. Graham Hume ends his spell with 41 runs and no wickets.
SIX! BOOM! It is a length ball, on off. Zadran clears his front leg and tonks it over the mid-wicket fence.

Swing and a miss! Najibullah Zadran thinks it should've been a wide but the umpire keeps his arms to himself. It is a short ball, angled across the left-hander. Zadran throws his blade at it but misses.
Hume goes full again, wide outside off. Nabi drives it gently towards covers and rotates the strike.
Fuller, wide outside off. Nabi reaches out and pushes it towards sweeper cover. They take two.
Graham Hume nails his wide yorker this time. Nabi shuffles across and tries to dig it out but misses it completely.
Change. Graham Hume comes back into the attack to bowl the penultimate over.
Back-of-a-length delivery, outside off. Mohammad Nabi waits for it and guides it down to third man. He gets off the mark with a single.
Mohammad Nabi is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Josh Little strikes and gets his second wicket. He persists with the short ball, on off. Ibrahim Zadran shuffles across and tries to scoop it away. It hits his gloves and goes to the keeper. Lorcan Tucker makes no mistake behind the sticks.
Commentary.Howout: c Lorcan Tucker b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Ibrahim Zadran uses the pace really well this time. Back of a length, on the bodyline. Ibrahim Zadran stays back and pulls it towards fine leg. It takes a couple of bounce into the ropes.
FOUR! Up and over! A short ball, outside off. Ibrahim Zadran stands tall and flays it over mid off for a boundary.
Good length, around the hips. Najibullah Zadran pulls it behind square on the leg side and gets a single.
Josh Little comes from 'round the wicket and serves a short ball, outside off. Ibrahim Zadran punches it to mid off. They take one.
Change. Josh Little is back into the attack now for his final over.
SIX! BANG! This maximum spoils the over for Gareth Delany. It is short, on middle and leg. Najibullah Zadran stays back and dispatches it over the square leg fence.
A single now as this is pushed to cover.
Short again, outside off. Najibullah Zadran cuts it aerially towards deep point. It is in the air for a while but dies before the fielder in the deep.
Gareth Delany drags his length back, outside off. Najibullah Zadran cuts it hard through covers and collects a brace.
Nicely bowled! A googly now, outside off. Najibullah Zadran stays back and tries to cut it away but misses.
Floated and full, outside off. Ibrahim Zadran drives it to covers for a single.
Change. Gareth Delany is back into the attack now.
A single now as this is worked to covers. 9 runs off the over.

Really good running! A short ball, on off. Ibrahim Zadran pulls it to deep mid-wicket. The batters push hard for two and get it in the end. It could've been a risky run but the fielder wasn't quite quick enough.
Adair serves a slower short ball, on off. Ibrahim Zadran tries to glide it over backward point but fails to connect.
Good length, on middle and leg. Najibullah Zadran mistimes his pull to the right of the keeper. They cross.
A short ball, around middle. Ibrahim Zadran pulls it to deep square leg. Graham Hume is quick to react in the deep and keeps it down to just one.
FOUR! Ibrahim Zadran has come out with an intent here. It is full, outside off. Ibrahim Zadran reaches out and lofts it over extra covers. One bounce and over the ropes.
Change. Mark Adair is back on.
Two more! Shorter and on middle, this is nudged on the leg side for two.
Another single as this is pushed towards cover.
A single as this is pulled towards mid-wicket for one.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Zadran is beaten as he tries to pull.
SIX! Over the fence! This is short and on middle, it is pulled hard and over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
On off, this is pushed to covers for one.
Change. Graham Hume is back on.
FOUR! In the gap! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On middle, defended.
On the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.
Najibullah Zadran is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a superb catch! The dangerous Zazai falls and at the right time for Ireland! A lovely slower oe outside off, Zazai is foxed by the lack of pace. He looks to hold his shot but it goes off the top edge towards short third man where Stirling dives forward and takes a really good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Paul Stirling b Fionn Hand

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and outside off, this is pulled through mid-wicket for two.
Angled into the pads, Zadran looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. A leg bye taken.
Change. Fionn Hand (2-0-22-0) is back on now.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
A single as this is hit down to long on.
On middle, this is pushed down to long off for one.
A loud appeal but turned down! On middle, Zadran looks to defend but misses to get hit on the pads. Maybe a little too high.
On the bounce this time! On middle, this is pulled hard but on the bounce to long on for one.
SIX! Just over! Tossed up on middle, Zazai lifts it high and over the long on fielder for a biggie. A good start to the over, pressure on the bowler.
Short ball, on off. Zazai pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! Back of a length, on off. This one flies off the deck. Hazratullah Zazai sways away from the line of the delivery. The umpire signals a wide.
Good length, on the body. Zadran taps it to mid on for a single.
Fraction short, on off. Ibrahim Zadran pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Zazai pulls this short ball to square leg for one.
Ibrahim Zadran walks in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Finally, Ireland manage to break the partnership! Gurbaz falls but he has played a good knock after a couple of failures. A short one, good pacey short one. Gurbaz looks to pull but the ball gets big on him. It goes off the top edge towards short third man where it is taken easily by Adair.
Commentary.Howout: c Mark Adair b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: Well bowled and well played in the end! Zazai moves away and he is followed with a yorker, it is jammed out through square leg for one.
Change. Josh Little (2-0-11-0) is back into the attack now.
Another single as this is nudged on the leg side for one.
Good stop but the single is not stopped! On off, this is hit hard towards the bowler who sticks a hand out. He makes a half stop. A run taken.
Another single as this is worked through mid-wicket.
Fuller and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Outside off, this is hit through covers for one more.
On middle, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Good length and on off, this is guided to point. FIFTY up for Rahmanullah Gurbaz. He has been in incredible form with the blade.

DRINKS! Good so far from Afghanistan. They began slowly but now have stepped on the accelerator. More of the same is what they will be hoping for. Ireland on the other hand, need wickets or they will be chasing a big score.
SIX! High and handsome. It looks like this has also left the ground. Full length, on off. Gurbaz steps down the track and smokes it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Hand serves it full, on off. Gurbaz blocks it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Rahmanullah Gurbaz is on a roll here! A short ball, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz plays it late and cuts it through the gap at point for a boundary.
WIDE! A sharp bouncer this time, on middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz ducks under it and the umpire signals a wide.

FOUR! Short and punished. Back of a length, this one lands on off and nips in off the deck. Rahmanullah Gurbaz stands tall and pulls it powerfully square on the leg side. It races away to the boundary.
It is fuller, wide outside off. Hazratullah Zazai reaches out and works it to mid off. The batters cross for a single.
A dot to end but the damage was done earlier on! Shorter, Gurbaz ducks under it.
WIDE! This is down the leg side. Wided.
FOUR! Third boundary in the over! On middle, this is pulled over mid-wicket for another boundary. Runs flowing now.
FOUR! Short and outside off, it is cut over third man for a boundary.
FOUR! That is a lovely shot! Fuller and outside off, it is lofted over cover for a boundary.
On middle, this is hit down towards long on, does not carry so just the one.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Two! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for two.
That has been hit hard but only for one! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled hard through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.
Shorter and outside off, Gurbaz looks to cut but misses.
On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
A dot to end! Tidy from Delany. On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Lovely shot! The slog sweep is out, it is played over short fine leg and into the fence.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Around off, this is cut to point.
On the stumps, Gurbaz is solid in defense. It goes towards mid-wicket for one.
On middle, this is defended.
Change. Gareth Delany comes into the attack now.
FOUR! The Powerplay ends with a boundary! A sedate one for Afghanistan! They are 41 for 0. Outside off, this is slapped through covers.
On off, this is guided to point for one.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Wided.
A single as this is pushed towards cover.
Confusion but safe! Outside off, Zazai slashes but misses. The keeper fumbles, Gurbaz wants a run but is sent back.
FOUR! That is the hit-me ball! Shorter and outside off, Zazai cuts it through point and it races away to the fence.
A single as this is nudged on the leg side.
Change of ends for Graham Hume. He is back into the attack as he replaces Josh Little.
Shorter and around off, this is guided to point.
FOUR! That has been hammered! Full and outside off, a half volley, this is smashed through covers for a boundary.
Shorter and around off, this is guided to point.
On middle, stays a touch low. Zazai looks to pull but misses.
Two! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled towards deep mid-wicket for two.
Swing and a miss! Shorter and on middle, Zazai looks to pull but misses.
A ripper to end the over! It is a length ball, outside off, angled across the right-hander. Rahmanullah Gurbaz shuffles across and lets it be. 8 runs off the over, a good one for Afghanistan.
Fraction short, on off. Zazai mistimes his pull to mid-wicket for one.
Length ball, on the pads, Rahmanullah Gurbaz flicks it to square leg for one.
Outside off, left alone.

FOUR! Hard luck for Ireland but Fionn Hand puts in a valiant effort to get to this high ball. It is a length ball, on off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz stays inside his crease and pulls it over mid on. Fionn Hand stationed there leaps high, but is unable to get to the ball. It races away to the boundary.
A short ball, on off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz stays back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket. It lands safely and they take two as there is protection in the deep.
Around off, this is guided to short third man. An excellent start from Hume.
Shorter yet again and outside off, Zazai looks to cut it but misses.
Good length and on off, Zazai looks to cut but misses.
Beaten! Length and on off, this lands and moves away. Zazai is beaten as he tries to defend.
On off, this is guided to point for one.
Good length and on off, defended.
Change. Graham Hume comes into the attack now. He is on his debut, will he be able to grab the opportunity with both hands?
A dot to end then! A good over from Little! On a length and around off, this is guided to point.
WIDE! Another extra as this is also bowled down the leg side.
Leading edge but lands short! On middle, Zazai looks to flick but closes the face of the bat early, it goes off a soft leading edge towards cover. Lands short.
On off, this is pushed to cover for one.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
On off, defended.
Little gets away with one! This is short and outside off, it is cut but the fielder at point, Curtis Campher dives to his left and makes a good stop.
Josh Little to share the new ball.
FOUR! Cut away! Gurbaz is off the mark in style and it is a very expensive first over by Adair! Short and outside off, Gurbaz cuts it past point and this races away to the fence.
Good length and on off, defended.
Quite watchful from Gurbaz to begin with! Outside off, shaping away. Left alone.
Good length and on off, this is pushed to covers.
A full ball on off, shaping away, Gurbaz drives it to mid off.
Zazai is off the mark! On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! Another one down the leg side. Wided again. Fortunately this one does not run away.
FIVE WIDES! That is the worst possible start for Adair and Ireland! Swing for him but the ball is way down the leg side. This swings away further, past the diving keeper and into the fine leg fence.

The match is set to begin. The Ireland players are seen to be in a huddle before they take their respective fielding positions. Followed by Hazratullah Zazai and Rahmanullah Gurbaz who walk out to open for Afghanistan. Mark Adair to start with the new ball. Here we go...

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Hazratullah Zazai (In for Hashmatullah Shahidi), Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Usman Ghani, Ibrahim Zadran, Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi (C), Azmatullah Omarzai, Rashid Khan, Naveen-ul-Haq, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Fazalhaq Farooqi.

Ireland (Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, Andy Balbirnie (C), Lorcan Tucker (WK), Harry Tector, Curtis Campher, Gareth Delany, George Dockrell, Fionn Hand (On T20I debut) (In for Andy McBrine), Mark Adair, Graham Hume (On T20I debut) (In for Barry McCarthy), Josh Little.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Ireland. They have opted to field first.

One win can do wonders! After quite a few losses on the trot, Ireland have won two in a row and they are now one win away from sealing the series with two games to go. A close fought win was followed by a dominant performance by the hosts and their confidence will be on cloud 9 at the moment. They’ll be eager to wrap the series up and with the form they are in, you can’t bet against them. One thing is for sure though, Afghanistan will come hard at them. They will be hurting from their last loss and will want to bag their first win of the tour and what better to do so in a must-win game for them. Will they be able to do so? We shall find out soon. Stay tuned for the toss and team updates..
